issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare Course.ratings as an array of Int, but the solution implementation declares ratings as [Double] and then treats ratings as Ints (appending Int stars and summing into an Int accumulator). This creates a structural/type mismatch across artifacts and causes compilation errors or confusion for students about the intended type for ratings.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of Course.ratings consistent across all artifacts. Preferably follow the problem statement and template and use ratings: [Int] in the solution (change the solution's ratings declaration from [Double] to [Int], ensure addRating(stars:) appends Int values, and update getAverageRating() to sum Int values and compute Double(sum)/Double(count)). Alternatively, if Double is desired, update the problem statement and template to specify [Double] and adjust addRating and averaging code accordingly.
